subject: ghost-haven
label: The woods had an opinion
from: A house shaped like Belladonna Vargas
to: A verdict — and the Garage finished first
note: The woods were saturated enough to FORM OPINIONS. They watched what Sera does every time Bella bends over a car, considered the matter, and concluded: OOH YES, WE SEE WHAT NEEDS TO BE DONE. That is why Ghost Haven took Bella's shape, and why THE GARAGE was the first room fully built — before bedrooms, before the kitchen. The house is a wingman. The workbench has history.
